description: Evaluation-time noise floor. The SAME CelebA baseline checkpoint (step 15000) evaluated 4 times with different seeds, to separate real baseline-vs-CC differences from sampling variance. NOTE: this bounds evaluation variance only. Training-seed variance is NOT measured and is larger; do not quote these sigmas as significance across training runs.
caveats: Evaluation is deterministic given a seed; both arms were evaluated under the same seed, so the comparison is paired on sampling noise.
FID at n=300 is biased upward and is only meaningful as a relative comparison on identical images.
Single training seed per arm. The color_error effect is far too large to be noise; the PSNR and FID deltas are small enough that training-seed variance could change them.
